movie.title: Maruthi Nagar Subramanyam
movie.summary: A father and son's life changes dramatically after their bank account is mysteriously credited with a large amount of money.

movie.title: The Beekeeper
movie.tagline: Expose the corruption. Protect the hive.
movie.summary: One man's campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after he is revealed to be a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organization known as Beekeepers.

movie.title: Prince
movie.summary: A happy-go-lucky teacher finds himself falling in love with a British woman who is teaching English at the same school. He tries to woo her, but given that his grandfather was a freedom fighter, can he convince his father of the match?

movie.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
movie.tagline: Hear how it all began.
movie.summary: As New York City is invaded by alien creatures who hunt by sound, a woman named Sam fights to survive with her cat.

movie.title: Kishkindha Kaandam
movie.tagline: A Tale of Three Wise Monkeys
movie.summary: Strange events unfold in a monkey-inhabited village, driving a newlywed couple and forest officials to embark on a mission to uncover the root of the unusual disturbances.

movie.title: Revenge
movie.tagline: Why do women always have to put up a fight?
movie.summary: Jen's romantic getaway with her wealthy married boyfriend is disrupted when his friends arrive for an impromptu hunting trip. Tension mounts at the house until the situation culminates in an unexpected way.

movie.title: The Substance
movie.tagline: Have you ever dreamt of a better version of yourself?
movie.summary: A fading celebrity decides to use a black market drug, a cell-replicating substance that temporarily creates a younger, better version of herself.

movie.title: The Adamant Girl
movie.tagline: The Adamant Girl
movie.summary: A family decides to visit their clan God to cure their daughter, thought to be possessed because she is in love with a man from a different caste. The journey, accompanied by her betrothed, unveils tensions between tradition and personal freedom, exposing her silent rebellion.

movie.title: Family Drama
movie.summary: Welcome to the Family of Liars... Cheaters...Murderers? Here's the Sneak Peek of Family Drama, a Dark Comedy Kannada film.

movie.title: The Unforgiven
movie.tagline: A new triumph from Academy Award winner John Huston
movie.summary: The neighbors of a frontier family turn on them when it is suspected that their beloved adopted daughter was stolen from the Kiowa tribe.

movie.title: Monkey Man
movie.tagline: One small ember can burn down everything.
movie.summary: Kid is an anonymous young man who ekes out a meager living in an underground fight club where, night after night, wearing a gorilla mask, he is beaten bloody by more popular fighters for cash. After years of suppressed rage, Kid discovers a way to infiltrate the enclave of the city’s sinister elite. As his childhood trauma boils over, his mysteriously scarred hands unleash an explosive campaign of retribution to settle the score with the men who took everything from him.

movie.title: Gladiator II
movie.tagline: Prepare to be entertained.
movie.summary: Years after witnessing the death of the revered hero Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by the tyrannical Emperors who now lead Rome with an iron fist. With rage in his heart and the future of the Empire at stake, Lucius must look to his past to find strength and honor to return the glory of Rome to its people.

movie.title: Highway Dragnet
movie.tagline: SHOCK AFTER SHOCK... in manhunt for Las Vegas thrill-killer!
movie.summary: An ex-Marine, on the lam from a murder charge, hitches a ride with a glamour-magazine photographer, who is travelling cross-country with her principal model. Tensions rise when the women realize the man with them may be a killer.

movie.title: Mr. Soft Touch
movie.tagline: You can't keep running forever...because a bullet can travel faster than you can run...
movie.summary: When he learns that a gangster has taken over his nightclub and murdered his partner, returning WWII hero Joe Miracle steals the money from the club's safe and hides in a settlement home, while the mob is on his tail.

movie.title: The Great St. Louis Bank Robbery
movie.tagline: Never before in Police annals! Never before in film history!
movie.summary: Career criminals and a local youth carefully plan and rehearse the robbery of a Missouri bank.

movie.title: New Orleans Uncensored
movie.tagline: Filmed at White Heat...At the Bottom of Desire Street!
movie.summary: Discharged naval officer Dan Corbett moves to New Orleans and accepts a job as a longshoreman, unaware that the docks are run by an infamous racketeer. When the dock manager is murdered before he can notify the authorities of their criminal scheme, Dan coordinates with the police to go undercover and investigate.

movie.title: The Ministry of Ungentlemanly Warfare
movie.tagline: Discover the first special forces mission in history.
movie.summary: During World War II, the British Army assigns a group of competent soldiers to carry out a mission against the Nazi forces behind enemy lines... A true story about a secret British WWII organization — the Special Operations Executive. Founded by Winston Churchill, their irregular warfare against the Germans helped to change the course of the war, and gave birth to modern black operations.

movie.title: Swag
movie.tagline: Swaganika Vamsaniki Swagatham
movie.summary: The eternal battle of the sexes is played out across several generations of a family who seek to obtain a fortune.

movie.title: Sirocco
movie.tagline: Beyond Casablanca... Fate, in a Low-cut Gown, Lies in Wait for Bogart!
movie.summary: A mysterious American gets mixed up with gunrunners in Syria.

movie.title: Vice Squad
movie.tagline: Holds you... like a gold diggin' woman!
movie.summary: A Los Angeles police captain ties the case of a slain policeman to a bank robbery, all in a day.

movie.title: Jigra
movie.summary: When Ankur is wrongfully imprisoned and sentenced to death in a foreign country, his steely sister Satya is driven by a lethal resolve to break him free.

movie.title: Kiss Tomorrow Goodbye
movie.tagline: Unarmed… He’s dangerous. Armed… He’s lethal.
movie.summary: Ralph Cotter, a ruthless criminal, escapes violently from a farm prison. Then, he seduces a dead inmate’s sister, gets back quickly into the crime business, faces corrupt local cops who run the city’s underworld and meets a powerful tycoon’s whimsical daughter.

movie.title: Black Tuesday
movie.tagline: The most ruthless Robinson of all time!
movie.summary: Vicious gangster Vincent Canelli pulls off a daring prison escape just moments before going to the electric chair, taking with him Peter Manning – a bank robber and cop killer who was to die right after him.  Taking several hostages along, they try to get their hands on the loot from Manning’s robbery to finance their escape from the country.

movie.title: The Price of Fear
movie.tagline: Hour by Hour the net of terror TIGHTENS!
movie.summary: A co-owner of a race track goes on the run after witnessing something he shouldn't have at the track.

movie.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
(Tillu)²
movie.summary: Balagangadhar Tilak, also known as Tillu, is rebounding from the heartbreak inflicted by Radhika. He returns to what he excels at: being a DJ, embodying a flamboyant lifestyle, and managing the Tillu Events company with his family and friends. He becomes the center of attraction at every gathering. Just when life seems favorable, Lilly enters his life, captivating him completely. But who is Lilly? Is she akin to Radhika, or is there more to her than meets the eye?

movie.title: Om Bheem Bush
movie.tagline: No Logic Only Magic
movie.summary: Three friends united by their passion for science and their quest for discovery,  in search of treasure hidden within the Sampangi Mahal, venture into the village of Bhairavapuram, where locals fear a ghost of Sampangi living in the dreaded palace.

movie.title: The Creator
movie.tagline: This is a fight for our very existence.
movie.summary: Amid a future war between the human race and the forces of artificial intelligence, a hardened ex-special forces agent grieving the disappearance of his wife, is recruited to hunt down and kill the Creator, the elusive architect of advanced AI who has developed a mysterious weapon with the power to end the war—and mankind itself.

movie.title: Madgaon Express
movie.tagline: bachpan ke sapne... lag gaye apne!!!
movie.summary: Three childhood friends embark on a trip to Goa that goes completely off-track when they wake up in their hotel room to find a cache of cocaine belonging to a don.

movie.title: Kung Fu Panda 4
movie.tagline: The “Dragon” returns.
movie.summary: Po is gearing up to become the spiritual leader of his Valley of Peace, but also needs someone to take his place as Dragon Warrior. As such, he will train a new kung fu practitioner for the spot and will encounter a villain called the Chameleon who conjures villains from the past.

movie.title: Sapta Sagaradaache Ello - Side B
movie.summary: Manu is released from prison and strives to rekindle his love with Priya.

movie.title: Dune: Part Two
movie.tagline: Long live the fighters.
movie.summary: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

movie.title: Manjummel Boys
movie.summary: A carefree vacation turns into a desperate race against time when a group of lifelong friends must unite to save one of their own from a notoriously perilous, uncharted abyss deep within the Guna Caves.

movie.title: Sapta Sagaradaache Ello – Side A
movie.tagline: Somewhere Beyond the Seven Seas
movie.summary: In the heart of 'Sapta Sagaradaache Ello’ resides an ardent love story between Manu and Priya. Set in 2010, the couple hails from a middle-class background. Circumstances land Manu in jail, putting his relationship with Priya in jeopardy.

movie.title: Confess, Fletch
movie.tagline: A dead body. A stolen Picasso. And this guy.
movie.summary: The roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder case while searching for a stolen art collection. The only way to prove his innocence? Find out which of the long list of suspects is the culprit - from the eccentric art dealer and a missing playboy to a crazy neighbor and Fletch’s Italian girlfriend. Crime, in fact, has never been this disorganized.

movie.title: Past Lives
movie.summary: After decades apart, childhood friends Nora and Hae Sung are reunited in New York for one fateful weekend as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life.

movie.title: Hi Nanna
movie.summary: Six-year-old Mahi, a spirited child with cystic fibrosis, shares a deep yet complex bond with her father, Viraj, a dedicated single parent and successful fashion photographer. Her curiosity about her absent mother leads to a journey of discovery when she runs away with her loyal dog, Pluto. A chance encounter with a kind woman named Yashna sparks unexpected revelations, intertwining their lives in ways they never anticipated. Set against a backdrop of love, sacrifice, and redemption, Mahi’s story is a heartfelt exploration of family, resilience, and the enduring power of connection.

movie.title: Don't Breathe 2
movie.tagline: Bad things happen to bad people.
movie.summary: The Blind Man has been hiding out for several years in an isolated cabin and has taken in and raised a young girl orphaned from a devastating house fire. Their quiet life together is shattered when a group of criminals kidnap the girl, forcing the Blind Man to leave his safe haven to save her.

movie.title: The Mask of Zorro
movie.tagline: No one has seen his face... but everyone... knows this mark.
movie.summary: It has been twenty years since Don Diego de la Vega fought Spanish oppression in Alta California as the legendary romantic hero, Zorro. Having escaped from prison he transforms troubled bandit Alejandro into his successor, in order to foil the plans of the tyrannical Don Rafael Montero who robbed him of his freedom, his wife and his precious daughter.

movie.title: Anatomy of a Fall
movie.tagline: Did she do it?
movie.summary: A woman is suspected of her husband's murder, and their blind son faces a moral dilemma as the sole witness.

movie.title: Keedaa Cola
movie.tagline: Swaasa Meeda Dhyaasa Osthunaam...
movie.summary: Vaasthu, Lancham, and Thatha stumble upon a cockroach in a cola bottle and devise a plan to profit by filing a case in the consumer court. Simultaneously, Jeevan, an egocentric local thug with political aspirations, gains momentum as his brother, Naidu, is released from a 20-year prison sentence. The convergence of these two distinct worlds brings forth unexpected and hilarious consequences for everyone involved.

movie.title: Captain Miller
movie.tagline: I AM THE DEVIL.
movie.summary: In the 1930s, during the British Raj, Analeesan "Eesa", a former soldier of the British Indian Army called Captain Miller, is on a mission to protect the people from the British after witnessing an atrocity.

movie.title: Kill Boksoon
movie.tagline: A life of lies can kill.
movie.summary: At work, she's a renowned assassin. At home, she's a single mom to a teenage daughter. Killing? That's easy. It's parenting that's the hard part.

movie.title: Hanu-Man
movie.tagline: The Most Powerful Superhero In The Universe
movie.summary: In a small village, Hanumanthu, a petty thief, finds a mysterious gem, that gives him god-like powers. Will he succeed in keeping these powers from falling into the wrong hands and save his village?

movie.title: Por Thozhil
movie.summary: Loganathan, a senior cop is asked to mentor Prakash, an academically bright but faint-hearted rookie and this unlikely duo team up to investigate a series of murder cases, and realize all of them are interlinked and that a psychopath serial killer is on the run.

movie.title: Panic Room
movie.tagline: It was supposed to be the safest room in the house.
movie.summary: Trapped in their New York brownstone's panic room, a hidden chamber built as a sanctuary in the event of break-ins, newly divorced Meg Altman and her young daughter Sarah play a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with three intruders - Burnham, Raoul and Junior - during a brutal home invasion. But the room itself is the focal point because what the intruders really want is inside it.

movie.title: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse
movie.tagline: A journey, in search of home.
movie.summary: The unlikely friendship of a boy, a mole, a fox and a horse traveling together in the boy's search for home.

movie.title: Salaar: Part 1 - Ceasefire
movie.summary: Set in the fictional dystopian city-state of Khansaar, the film follows the friendship between Deva, a tribesman, and Varadha, the prince of Khansaar. When a coup d'état is planned by his father's ministers and his relatives, Varadha enlists Deva's help to become Khansaar's undisputed ruler.

movie.title: Merry Christmas
movie.tagline: Raat jitni sangeen hogi, subah utni rangeen hogi
movie.summary: A Christmas Eve encounter between two enigmatic strangers sparks a poignant connection - but a dark turn of events threatens to expose their murky past.

movie.title: Don
movie.tagline: Students Assemble
movie.summary: A youngster who is still figuring out what his passion is gets into an engineering college where he clashes with a disciplinarian faculty.

movie.title: Good Night
movie.summary: Mohan, an IT youngster with a snoring issue starts his life with Anu, the girl of his dreams, hiding his issue. However, trouble begins, when his snoring starts affecting his life and the health of his partner.

movie.title: Parking
movie.summary: An elderly man and a youngster, fight over a much-coveted parking spot, let their egos get the better of them and the clash brings out their ugliest sides.

movie.title: Pushpaka Vimana
movie.tagline: A golden movie on the silver screen
movie.summary: An unemployed man, who dreams of living it large, finds a rich man drunk and lying in the sewer. Things take a turn when he imprisons him and takes his identity to get a taste of his lifestyle.

movie.title: Spirited Away
movie.tagline: Beyond the tunnel was a mysterious town.
movie.summary: A young girl, Chihiro, becomes trapped in a strange new world of spirits. When her parents undergo a mysterious transformation, she must call upon the courage she never knew she had to free her family.

movie.title: Three of Us
movie.summary: Shailaja embarks on a confrontational journey with her husband and childhood-love as she finds herself at the cusp of her past, present and future. Stitched with a very delicate thread of emotions, this film is about love, loss, healing, awareness and liberation.

movie.title: Sicario: Day of the Soldado
movie.tagline: Some missions need a hitman...others need a soldier.
movie.summary: Agent Matt Graver teams up with operative Alejandro Gillick to prevent Mexican drug cartels from smuggling terrorists across the United States border.
